runtime_identity.authority: Generated from canonical production runtime source records; delivery, publication and acceptance remain separate.

scope: 120 warmup and720 measured ticks per run, eight real paid casters, production first-four elements/four deliveries; simulation step only. No event retention, snapshots, sockets, rendering, physical input, long soak or extreme capacity acceptance. No resource refill or cap override. Optional trace is sampled outside step timing; no trace hash is used by gameplay or networking. Manifest identity may be stale during development; source hashes identify the measured files.
